scope: Node state tests, filesystem resource inspection and HTTP fetch only; no browser rendering or browser interaction

checks.name: Fresh state is valid and independent
Selection grants no reward; confirmation requires a choice
Gold reward grants exactly once under 100 repeated activations
Item rewards increment exactly their own inventory
Claim survives a serialized session round trip
Near-max potion heals only 7 HP and consumes exactly one
Full HP blocks consumption with readable reason
Zero potions blocks healing with readable reason
Normal +20 heal and zero quantity after last use
Purchase subtracts price, adds item and reduces stock
Sold-out blocks repeated purchase without mutation
Insufficient gold differs from sold-out and preserves state
Exact balance succeeds, then no negatives across every offer
Reward, purchase and potion share the same run data
All runtime resource references resolve locally; RGBA atlas is 1536×1024; four fonts and two OFL notices present
Existing HTTP server returns byte-identical runtime resources
